title: 第6章 谈第7章 圣爷第8章 旧事
slug: 玄幻我有机甲鬼才愿意去修仙
content_zh:
石泉水见到这金小姐时，还是忍不住多看了几眼。
天生丽质的她，一脸的病容，像极了红楼中的黛玉。
印堂偏下的位置有三粒细小的黑痣，在秀发的遮掩下多了一层神秘。
“咳咳咳。”
金霓羽咳嗽并不厉害，但每咳嗽一下，她的胸口便会剧烈的起伏，连呼吸都变得急促起来。
身旁的丫鬟阿兰从腰间拿出一个药瓶，倒出一粒黑色药丸。
“等等，这药小姐吃了多少年了？”
石泉水瞧了一眼这黑色药丸，感觉在哪里见过，好像不是什么好东西。
金霓羽刚想回答，剧烈的咳嗽让她连开口的机会都没有。
阿兰看小姐如此样子，眼睛一红，但没有落下眼泪，只是侧过头看向一侧，不忍看下去。
“自从小姐七岁那年走火入魔后，这咳嗽病便再没好过，只有服了这药，方才好些。”
石泉水夹起比黄豆还小的药丸，放在鼻下闻了闻，忽然记起这是什么东西了，大骇道：“好大的贼胆，居然用荒蛇古毒入药。”
“咳咳咳......”金霓羽听到‘荒蛇古毒’这四个字猛地抬起头，眼里闪过了一丝的慌乱。
她咳了好一会方才有所缓减，“就是号称连渡劫期粘上一丝都必死无疑的天下第二奇毒的荒蛇古毒？”
阿兰从石泉水手里接过药丸，有些迟疑地握在手里，忽然想起了什么，“若是毒药，小姐服用这么多年，岂不是.....”
金霓羽抢过药丸直接塞入嘴里，阿兰想阻止根本来不及。
服药过后，咳嗽略微好了一些，惨白的脸上也有了些许血色。
“我刚好想到一件事，就是刚才在城南那边，看到一个和小姐身上香气一样的女子。”
古泉水摸向怀里，拿出一张创口贴交给丫鬟。
这金小姐到底是什么病，又为何用荒蛇古毒入药，他并不知道事情原委，更不是医师，无法阻止其服药。

“这是什么？”
阿兰看不出这小东西是什么，用来擦嘴也太小，可捧在手里却感觉是温温的，连忙递给小姐。
金霓羽自从走火入魔后，没办法修炼，便整日埋于书丛中，也因为此，她才能熬过那些最黑暗的日子。
可博览群书的她也不知道这东西是什么。
“贴在额头试试。”
这创口贴，是石泉水赊来的，毕竟距离发作也不到一小时，他不忍看到这小姐受罪，便想试试。
至于他自己，顶多再死皮赖脸一次了，反正好死不如赖活着，连妖兽便便都涂了，还有什么做不出的。
不过，有件事让他很稀奇，就是身上的气味在不知不觉中被机甲吸收分解了，也因为此，他刚才才斗胆试着用手去触摸玄幻锁。
“小姐？”
阿兰拿不定主意，看到小姐点头，才大胆贴在她额头。
“怎么样？”
石泉水也不知道效果如何，刚贴了片刻，便有些焦急地询问。
金霓羽摇了摇头，但到贴上后，额头上一阵阵清凉，咳嗽了几声便没再咳嗽。
以往吃了药，也需半个时辰，咳嗽方能大大缓解。
“多谢道友。”
阿兰则代为行礼，回头看小姐苍白的脸上已经红扑扑的，宛若正常人一般，不禁心中一喜。
content_en:
When Shi Quanshui saw Miss Jin, he couldn't help but look at her a few more times.
She is naturally beautiful and has a sick look on her face, which looks very much like Daiyu in Red Mansions.
There are three small black moles on the lower part of Yintang, which are hidden by the hair and add a layer of mystery.
"Cough cough cough."
Jin Niyu's cough was not severe, but every time she coughed, her chest would rise and fall violently, and her breathing would become rapid.
The maid next to her, Alan, took out a medicine bottle from her waist and poured out a black pill.
"Wait a minute, how many years has the lady been taking this medicine?"
Shi Quanshui took a look at the black pill and felt that he had seen it somewhere before. It didn't seem to be a good thing.
Just as Jin Niyu wanted to answer, she coughed violently and didn't even have a chance to speak.
Alan's eyes turned red when he saw the lady like this, but he didn't shed tears. He just turned his head and looked to one side, unable to bear to look any further.
"Ever since she became possessed when she was seven years old, her cough has never gotten better. Only after taking this medicine did she get better."
Shiquan Shui picked up a pill that was smaller than a soybean, put it under his nose and smelled it. Suddenly he remembered what it was, and said in shock: "What a brave thief, he actually used the ancient poison of the wild snake as medicine."
"Cough cough cough..." Jin Niyu suddenly raised his head when he heard the words 'Desolate Snake Ancient Poison', a trace of panic flashed in his eyes.
She coughed for a while before she could calm down, "Is it the Ancient Desolate Snake Poison, which is said to be the second most bizarre poison in the world and will kill you if even a trace of it sticks to it during the Tribulation Period?"
Alan took the pill from Shiquanshui and held it hesitantly in his hand. Suddenly he remembered something, "If it is poison, and Miss has been taking it for so many years, wouldn't it be..."
Jin Niyu snatched the pill and stuffed it into his mouth. Alan couldn't stop him in time.
After taking the medicine, my cough was slightly better, and my pale face also gained some color.
"I just happened to think of something, that is, I just saw a woman with the same fragrance as the lady in the south of the city."
Guquan Shui reached into his arms, took out a band-aid and handed it to the maid.
What kind of disease did Miss Jin have and why she used the ancient poison of the wild snake as medicine? He didn't know the whole story, and he was not a doctor, so he couldn't stop her from taking the medicine.
"What is this?"
Alan couldn't tell what this little thing was, and it was too small to wipe his mouth, but it felt warm in his hand, and he quickly handed it to the lady.
Since Jin Niyu became possessed, she has been unable to practice and has been buried in books all day long. Because of this, she was able to survive the darkest days.
But even though she is well-read, she doesn’t know what this thing is.
"Try it on your forehead."
This band-aid was bought on credit from Shiquan Water. After all, it was less than an hour before the attack. He couldn't bear to see the young lady suffer, so he wanted to try it.
As for himself, he could only be shameless once more. Anyway, it was better to die than to live. Even if he was smeared with monster poop, there was nothing he could do.
However, one thing made him very strange, that is, the smell on his body was unknowingly absorbed and decomposed by the mecha. Because of this, he just boldly tried to touch the fantasy lock with his hand.
"Miss?"
Alan couldn't make up his mind, so when he saw the lady nodding, he boldly placed it on her forehead.
"How's it going?"
Shi Quan Shui didn't know how effective it was. After applying it for a moment, he asked anxiously.
Jin Niyu shook his head, but after putting it on, his forehead felt cool for a while, and he coughed a few times and then stopped coughing.
In the past, it would take half an hour for the cough to be greatly relieved after taking medicine.
"Thank you, fellow Taoist."
Alan saluted on his behalf. Looking back, he saw that the young lady's pale face was already flushed, just like a normal person, and he couldn't help feeling happy.
